title: developing laminar MIXED CONVECTION in a vertical parallel-plate channel with asymmetric isothermal walls, EXACT tier (referent DERIVED in exact_t16.py from the Boussinesq equations; NO paper is used and none is on disk)
capability_grid_cell: mixed convection x laminar x 2D (docs/capability/heat-transfer_GRID.md) -- registered as CAN NOT DO / not attempted at HEAD c9ff33d9

roache_floors.source: scripts/roache_triple.py, imported by name (MESH_STANDARD.md section 10.5, chief ruling 01967a7b); the comparator defines neither and REFUSES if these numbers differ from the import

G1.quantity: v(Y = 0.25)/U0 on the station row, 4-point Lagrange at cell centres
G1.band_ground: 3.0x the DERIVED fine-level discretisation error 7.815e-05 (exact_t16.discrete_expectation); the coarse (1.256e-03) and medium (3.129e-04) levels are predicted OUTSIDE it

G1b.quantity: Y_max, location of the maximum upflow on the station row, from the cubic through the 4 cells around it
G1b.band_ground: 3.0x the DERIVED fine-level error 7.812e-05; coarse (1.250e-03) and medium (3.125e-04) predicted OUTSIDE

G3.quantity: tau_hot / tau_cold from the half-cell wall gradients of v on the station row
G3.band_ground: 3.0x the DERIVED fine-level error 3.750e-04; coarse (6.000e-03) and medium (1.500e-03) predicted OUTSIDE

G2.quantity: RMS over the station row of (T - T_lin)/dT
G2.grading: ABSOLUTE FLOOR (EXACT-class row): the linear T is an exact solution of the continuous problem for ANY velocity field and is in the null space of the scheme's truncation error, so its triple is EXACT/DEGENERATE by construction and rule 5 (2) would return NOT A RESULT for a row that cannot be wrong by discretisation; the triple states are PRINTED, the verdict is the floor

C_CONV.what: iterative convergence: initial residuals of Uy, T and p_rgh <= 1e-6 at EVERY iteration of the final 10 percent; Ux is a near-degenerate cross-channel component and is REPORTED, never gated (L-338). The floor is the FAMILY'S 1e-6, unweakened, and it is registered because it was MEASURED REACHABLE on the disclosed scratch probe of this exact case: p_rgh fell 5.3e-03 -> 2.0e-05 -> 6.4e-06 -> 2.7e-06 -> 1.1e-06 -> 4.7e-07 by 3 400 of the registered 10 000 iterations at N = 20, once the outlet carried the CONSISTENT prghPressure condition

W1.what: DEVELOPMENT witness and gate-(1) precondition: the rows at station -16b, -8b, -4b, +4b, +8b must agree with the graded station row in v/U0 to 2e-4 and in T/dT to 1e-6.  Exceeding it means the station is NOT in the fully developed regime the referent describes -> the level is NOT A RESULT under rule 5 clause (1).  This witness, not an assumed entrance-length correlation, is what entitles the rung to compare against a FULLY DEVELOPED closed form

C_G.what: operand identity (L-331): nu, Pr, beta, TRef, g, T_hot, T_cold, b, U0, N are READ FROM THE CASE FILES, printed, and G = Gr/Re recomputed from them must equal 48 to 1e-9; the DERIVED reversal threshold 72 is recomputed and the margin printed

C_MASS.what: the station row's cell-volume-weighted mean of v must equal U0 to 1e-6 relative -- the referent normalises on the MEAN velocity, so a station row whose mean is not U0 is not the profile the closed form describes

C_ORDER.what: cell-ordering control: the station row's T must fall monotonically from hot to cold with the registered slope -dT/b to 1e-6 relative; a transposed ordering (y-fastest) shows a constant row and REFUSES

C_PZ.what: planted-zero control per reader (rule 3, L-340 sizing): a POINT plant for the point readers G1/G1b/G3/W1, and an ALL-ROW ALTERNATING-SIGN plant for the RMS reader G2 -- a constant offset is invisible to an RMS-about-the-linear-fit reader BY CONSTRUCTION, so the plant is shaped to the reader; both arms, a measured detection ladder, and REFUSAL on a blind reader

predictions.P1: G1, G1b and G3 triples CONVERGING with observed order p in [1.5, 2.5]; the derived expectation is p = 2.000 on all three
predictions.P2: G1 relative deviation at f in [+5.47e-05, +1.02e-04] (the derived +7.815e-05 within 30 percent), POSITIVE sign; c and m OUTSIDE the +-2.4e-4 band
predictions.P2b: Y_max error at f in [-1.02e-04, -5.47e-05] (the derived -7.812e-05 within 30 percent), NEGATIVE sign
predictions.P2c: tau_hot/tau_cold relative deviation at f in [+2.62e-04, +4.87e-04] (the derived +3.750e-04 within 30 percent), POSITIVE sign
predictions.P3: NO FLOW REVERSAL anywhere on the station row: v > 0 in every cell, and the cold-wall shear is POSITIVE.  G = 48 is exactly 2/3 of the DERIVED reversal threshold 72.  A reversed cell at the station FALSIFIES either the derivation or the solve and the rung reports it as such
predictions.P4: W1 development witness under 2e-5 ON THE GRADED READER and under 2e-4 in the row max-norm of v/U0 on every level at the registered station
predictions.P5: G2 RMS < 1e-7 at f -- the linear temperature field is exact for any velocity field
predictions.P6: all three levels meet C_CONV and C_PLAT within their registered endTime
